extraction_notes: The datasheet covers 2N7002L and 2V7002L; the requested 2N7002LT1G ordering identifier is listed on p. 1 as 2N7002LT1G.

Figures 1 through 4 on p. 3 were usable and digitized as typical curves. Figure 1 contains eight VGS traces; Figure 2 contains -55 degC, 25 degC, and 125 degC transfer traces, of which the 25 degC trace was digitized.

No capacitance-versus-VDS figure was published. Ciss, Coss, and Crss are transcribed from the p. 2 typical-value table; CGDMAX and CGDMIN would therefore be held equal to the table Crss value in the downstream VDMOS fit.

No gate-charge Qg, body-diode reverse-recovery trr, or RthJC value was published. The p. 1 thermal table publishes RthJA MAX = 556 degC/W on FR-5 board and 417 degC/W on alumina substrate; the strict schema has no thermal fields.

The p. 2 off-characteristics table publishes V(BR)DSS MIN = 60 V at VGS = 0 V and ID = 10 uA, and IDSS MAX = 1.0 uA at TJ = 25 degC or 500 uA at TJ = 125 degC, both at VDS = 60 V; only the breakdown value has a dedicated schema field.

The p. 2 table publishes VSD with a negative sign for the source-drain reference direction; the body-diode value is recorded as the positive forward-voltage magnitude while retaining the published sign in conditions.

The p. 2 table also publishes VDS(on) maximum values of 3.75 V at VGS = 10 V, ID = 0.5 A and 0.375 V at VGS = 5 V, ID = 0.05 A; the strict schema has no separate VDS(on) field, so these are noted but not duplicated as RDS(on) values.
